title: Learning by ear with no teacher
summary: He learned song by song, by listening and whistling, with no teacher, and practiced his lip himself.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Well, Mr. Thomas, how, how, you said when you first started you could play only three songs. How did you gradually get from there to the point where you could learn more?

Well, I just kept, I just kept playing. I take one song at a time. Well, who'd teach it to you? Did you just listen? Nobody. We had no teacher. What'd you do? Did you sit down and try to figure it out alone? I just, just listen to other, probably just whistle numbers and we just play them.
Would he whistle a tune to you and you? Yeah, yeah, yeah, that's how, that's how we used to do.
Well, how did you ever learn to use your lips right? Well, I just practiced. That's all.
